name: Light the Vault — one verb taught by light, the whole vault reachable

proves.simplicity: three verbs + a four-line HUD collapsed to ONE verb (light a crystal) and a single glow meter, zero instruction text
proves.flow: lighting a crystal wakes its nearest neighbours, so the frontier pulls the player outward -- the light teaches itself
proves.complete: the nearest-neighbour spread reaches every one of the 186 crystals from the seed -- the whole vault is lightable, none strandable-dark

realSeams: drive-build light-the-vault verb + spatial spread + glow meter
